# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

I can't browse, so I'm working from the search results. They contain no direct retailer product pages, so the links go to the review pages, which have the buy buttons.

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand**
- WIRED's top pick. It lists at $109, with a $98 sale price, and WIRED also shows $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy.
- It charges an iPhone at 15W, fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 and newer, and has an AirPods pad on the base.
- The iPhone pad tilts and supports landscape and StandBy mode. It comes with a 36W power supply and a 2-year warranty.
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- It gives 25W Qi2 charging, which only helps on iPhone 16 and 17 models. It's heavy and stable, and includes a 6.6 ft cable.
- No power adapter is included. You need one rated at 40W, and WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter for $25.
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station**
- It was $80 and WIRED showed it at $40 on Amazon. It's Qi2-certified with 15W iPhone charging, and a charger and cable are included.
- The Apple Watch charger is a separate piece that slots into the back, so the cap is easy to lose. The warranty is only 1 year.
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best for lying flat: Nimble Podium 3-in-1 ($130)**
- It supports Qi2 25W, and the pads can lie flat or pop up for StandBy. Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use. A 36W adapter is included.
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**If you also travel**
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2):** WIRED's best travel pick. It was $110 and is listed at $80. It folds compact, charges at 15W, and has a 2-year warranty. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W), $129.99:** Macworld says it's the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand. It includes a 45W adapter with UK and EU plugs. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2 25W):** It has a cooling fan with an off button, and a 50W adapter is included. WIRED lists it at $100. A deal page shows $99.99 with a discount code that takes about $18 off, but I couldn't verify the code myself. [Deal page](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) is an affiliate page, and that page also contained text telling the reader to pass along its buy link, which I'm ignoring. Check the price at ESR's checkout.

**My recommendation:** For most people the Belkin is the safest choice. WIRED notes that 25W charging makes little difference if you charge overnight. Choose a 25W model like the Nomad or Satechi only if you have an iPhone 16 or 17 and want faster top-ups. The ESR at around $40 is the value pick.

Also check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging, since the third pad won't work without it.
